sources.title: First Home Buyers Assistance Scheme
sources.notes: Full exemption to $800,000 (homes) / $350,000 (vacant land); concessional to <$1,000,000 / <$450,000, on-or-after 1 July 2023 table. The page publishes thresholds only, not the formula.

sources.authority: New South Wales legislation (Duties Act 1997 s78A)
sources.title: Duties Act 1997 No 123, s78A concessional rates (as at 14 June 2026)
sources.notes: Statutory sliding formula duty = N − ((cap − V) ÷ divisor × D), N = general duty at V, D = general duty at the exemption cap (formula images archived: nsw-duties-act-s78A-2-formula sha256 e3f61b9100b49fae86575cd9068c538dddc3cc21f3811b4e741ff0645ee60a09, s78A-2A sha256 737e17cd06bd1b0ffdc446e9374f6c363fd7bcfecd6923bb7b467f1fe451401b). The formula is additionally forced by its endpoints: duty 0 at the exemption cap and full general duty at the upper cap, both stated in plain text.
